body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success against Composure, reduce the maximum dice it may commit to its next Action by 1, minimum 2.

surges.html: Choose one additional creature within 1 unit of the target; compare this Action against it as well.
Reduce the target's maximum dice by 1 additional die for this effect, minimum 2.

rider.title: TIME THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread after a creature declares an Action or Reaction to give it +1 or -1 Defense against that effect.
